text: You can have been acquainted with it only since I came to Bath, excepting as you might hear me previously spoken of in my own family.” “I knew you by report long before you came to Bath. I had heard you described by those who knew you intimately. I have been acquainted with you by character many years. Your person, your disposition, accomplishments, manner; they were all present to me.” Mr Elliot was not disappointed in the interest he hoped to raise. No one can withstand the charm of such a mystery.
